info.title: Minimal & Fast Build System
info.description: A typed C# build system using Roslyn scripting. Write build scripts as real C# code.

commands.name: clean
commands.description:
Remove artifacts, temp files, and containers
help, -h, --help  Show this help
-v, --version     Show version number

options.name: --container
options.description: Remove the project's warm Docker container (clears caches)

options.name: --all
options.description:
Remove all of the above
(no flags)          Default: remove artifacts and temp only

commands.name: commit
commands.description: Commit all changes with AI-generated message

options.name: --all
options.description: Run all applicable release steps non-interactively

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Preview release steps without making changes
Release runs a mandatory build verification (ando run) before any steps.
Release workflow steps (selectable via interactive checklist):
1. commit   - Commit uncommitted changes (AI-generated message)
2. bump     - Bump version (uses type from command line)
3. docs     - Update documentation using Claude (auto-commits)
4. push     - Push commits to remote
5. publish  - Run build with publish profile (ando run -p publish --dind --read-env)

options.name: --file
options.description: Use specific build file instead of build.csando
